end.summary:
Discussed how bird feet and beaks relate to movement and feeding.
Linked leaf features such as thorns, waxy surfaces, and thin leaves to habitats.
Explained that plants are living because they grow and make food in their leaves.
Atharv gave 4 unaided correct links out of 6 for plant features; bird-feature link was not yet independently correct.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised observing features and explaining their purpose using examples such as webbed feet for swimming and waxy leaves for shedding water. They also explained that plants grow, produce new leaves, and make food in their leaves. The bird-features explanation needs more practice; revisit one bird at a time by asking, “What does this shape help it do?” At home, observe a bird or plant and record one feature and its possible use.
